> Delete the guidance lines of this template as you fill it. Each one starts with `>`. A quote that you add yourself stays. Keep the filled body under about 250 words. The QA steps do not count toward that cap.

## Related issues

> Write one bullet for each issue that this pull request relates to, one issue per bullet.
> To close an issue on merge, start its bullet with a closing keyword: close, closes, closed, fix, fixes, fixed, resolve, resolves or resolved. Letter case does not matter.
> Use `Fixes` for a bug. Use `Closes` or `Resolves` for other work.
> Give each issue its own keyword. GitHub needs the full syntax for each issue that it closes.
> A keyword closes the issue only when the pull request merges into the default branch. On any other base branch, GitHub ignores the keyword. It creates no link, and the merge leaves the issue open. Close the issue by hand when the work reaches the default branch.
> To link an issue without closing it, write `Part of #<number>` or `Related to #<number>`. The issue shows the pull request in its timeline and stays open.
> Tick each acceptance criterion in that issue as it is met. Never copy the criteria here.

- Fixes #

## What changed

> Write one to three bullets about behavior. Do not list files.

## Why

> Give the reason for the change when the linked issue gives none.
> Give a short reason for each choice that departs from the issue, from the project's usual patterns or from a stated requirement.
> Leave out the reasoning that the issue already gives. Put rejected alternatives and red-then-green transcripts in the commit messages. Delete this section when it is empty.

## QA steps

> Write a numbered playbook that a human follows in the browser or the console.
> Give each step one action and what the human should see after it.
> Add a screen recording for a change to the UI. Delete this section only when the change has no behavior that a human can try.

1.

## Verified

> Give the test command and its pass count, and the CI result. Put manual steps in QA steps.

-

## Before you approve

> List breaking changes, migrations, config or cache effects, a rollback that is not a plain revert, and known gaps. Delete this section when it is empty.
